notes: Not automated: [On Play] Draw 1 card and place 1 card from your hand at the top of your deck. Then, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

abilities.text: [On K.O.] DON!! 1: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

steps.text: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards
